title: Composition-graded versus allele-general signatures across axes in WWOX-deficient human organoids: within-radial-glia contrasts across knockout, SCAR12-class and WOREE-class lines separate a signature that scales with the progenitor fraction from one that does not
source: harness-engineering (plan), DREAM-4 pass 2026-11-08; disease-models/wwox/research/dream4_20261108/ (README, needs_human_neural_systems.tsv); needs.json human-neural observations of ISR, PDH, lactate, mitochondrial, inhibitory, GABA-chloride, Wnt, mTOR, glia and NRF2 needs (week-15 bulk organoid, GSE156243, WiBR3 hESC knockout, 4 v 2 libraries); gse156243/independent_reanalysis_wnt_vs_maturation_20261025.md (composition scores collinear with genotype, cannot separate); PMID 42397075 original text and Figure 1 (main knockout is the iPSC line JH-iPS11, patient lines WOREE and SCAR12, SOX2-positive share at week 7 graded WT < patient lines < knockout, severity gradient stated in the text; MYC-positive share of SOX2-positive cells raised about equally in knockout and both patient lines per needs.json, week 16); census_reconciliation_it7_20261029.md C8 (E-MTAB-14792: preprint methods, one library per condition)
causal_statement: IPOTESI: the human-neural sign of at least ten needs rests on one week-15 bulk deposit of a WiBR3 hESC knockout whose composition differs from wild type and cannot be separated from genotype by adjustment (2 wild-type libraries); the 2026 single-cell study uses a different background (JH-iPS11) and adds patient-derived lines whose progenitor fraction is intermediate; a signature that is composition-driven should scale with that fraction (knockout greater than patient lines greater than wild type) and shrink within radial glia, while a cell-autonomous or allele-general change should be present within radial glia at similar size in all three mutant lines, as the MYC-positive share is; the repository has this contrast stated for MYC and for Wnt only, and carries the line identity in none of the needs; composition-driven, cell-autonomous and regional-identity drift (non-cortical shift in the bulk reanalysis) remain concurrent readings, and the first and third would turn several 'pathway' needs into one phenomenon seen through different gene sets, which is a hypothesis, not an observation.
falsifier: Within radial glia of E-MTAB-14792 (once accessible), the gene sets of the ISR, glycolysis, OXPHOS, Wnt, NRF2 and GABA-marker needs show the same direction and similar size in the knockout, SCAR12-class and WOREE-class lines as in the pseudobulk, with no grading by progenitor fraction (cell-autonomous reading survives); or the pseudobulk effect is absent in the patient lines while the progenitor fraction is raised (then the signature is knockout-specific, not composition-graded); or the single-cell lines carry no replicate and the contrast reduces to concordance of direction only, in which case no reading is resolved.
transfer_limit: the bulk deposit and the single-cell deposit are different genetic backgrounds (WiBR3 hESC versus JH-iPS11 iPSC), so a within-cell-type result in the second replicates or fails to replicate a signature, it does not adjust the first; the week-7 progenitor fractions are hand readings of one figure; the single-cell study has one library per condition in its preprint methods (published methods not read for this); E-MTAB-14792 answers HTTP 403 and the release request is an unsent draft for the operator; transcript level only, no protein or activity; organoids are immature tissue by construction; no direction is carried to a compound and nothing here changes a need, a card or the ranking. Not medical advice.
